system.description:
Ornate Box (Large) (Passive): This item consumes 3 Stored Item Slots (SIS), but provides 6 SIS. You may only put items in this SIS with a max size of 1 Item Slot. Items stored in the Ornate Box do not need to be the same. You may only benefit from one Chest, Ornate Box, or Craft Pouch at a time.

3 Item Slots · 1000gc · Stored Baggage, rulebook p.201
